intent: Make Metrolist (com.metrolist.music) always available on the phone, including during the 23:00-05:00 night curfew, so it can be opened at any hour.
scope: focus_owner/assets/policy.json - night_allowed_packages (the list the installed Device Owner app actually enforces)
phone_focus_mode/config.sh - NIGHT_WHITELIST (the rooted-stack mirror, kept in sync; not deployed on this unrooted Pixel 6a)
Non-goal: no change to the day allowlist (Metrolist was already there), the curfew window, or any other package
changes: Added com.metrolist.music to night_allowed_packages in focus_owner/assets/policy.json
Added com.metrolist.music to NIGHT_WHITELIST in phone_focus_mode/config.sh with a one-line rationale comment, keeping the two policy sources mirrored
Rebuilt and installed the focus_owner release APK via ~/.claude/scripts/phone_deploy.sh (build 4, data-preserving adb install -r)

verification.command: adb shell dumpsys package com.metrolist.music | grep hidden=
verification.evidence: Before deploy at 23:13 device time (curfew active): hidden=true. After deploy: hidden=false.

verification.command: adb -s 23181JEGR08034 pull <installed base.apk> && unzip -p live.apk assets/flutter_assets/assets/policy.json
verification.evidence: Pulled the installed APK back off the phone after deploy (build 4) and extracted its bundled policy asset: day metrolist True, night metrolist True, and it byte-for-byte matches the committed assets/policy.json. The APK installed BEFORE the change had day True / night False, confirming the night list was the actual gap.
topResumedActivity=ActivityRecord{u0 com.metrolist.music/.MainActivityAlias t290} - app launched and held the foreground during an active curfew window.

verification.command: adb shell dumpsys device_policy | grep -A1 'Device Owner'
verification.evidence: admin=ComponentInfo{com.kuhy.focus_owner/...FocusDeviceAdminReceiver} still set after the -r install; Device Owner not lost.

verification.command: python -m pytest python_pkg/focus_policy/ -q && (cd focus_owner && flutter test)
verification.evidence: 137 passed (focus_policy, which parses config.sh) and 94 passed (focus_owner Dart, including the test that loads the real committed policy.json asset).

risks: Loosens the night curfew by one app: Metrolist is now reachable at 23:00-05:00, which is a deliberate policy relaxation the user requested. Not verified whether its playback works at night: it is a YouTube Music client, and always_blocked_packages plus the always-on bravedns VPN block YouTube at the network layer, so streaming may still be cut even though the app now opens.
policy.json is a bundled Flutter asset, so any future list edit is inert until the APK is rebuilt and reinstalled - editing the JSON alone changes nothing on the device.
The phone_focus_mode/config.sh edit is currently inert (this Pixel 6a is unrooted and runs the focus_owner Device Owner stack instead); it exists to stop the two lists drifting.
rollback: Remove com.metrolist.music from night_allowed_packages in focus_owner/assets/policy.json and from NIGHT_WHITELIST in phone_focus_mode/config.sh, then re-run ~/.claude/scripts/phone_deploy.sh focus_owner --release.
After rollback, confirm with adb shell dumpsys package com.metrolist.music | grep hidden= that it reports hidden=true inside the curfew window, and that Device Owner is still set.
